name: The bullfight from the east hill
basis: solved roughly: looks west-south-west from the wooded slope east of the track. Direction fixed by the dome on the skyline (a hill 3.85 km west); position from the railway, the two track rails and the ring, to about 13 px. The lens angle is uncertain (the skyline right of the dome wants it narrower), so the standpoint could be 100 ft or more nearer or farther
method: tools/solve_ring_hill.py; ring solved at 38.789228, -105.122788 (86 ft north of its earlier mapped position)
